summary: Official District Surendranagar land-record custody and official municipal/state GIS map services were found, but no anonymous Surendranagar parcel ID-plus-polygon response was verified. No sample GeoJSON is retained; runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Gujarati discovery queries and actual result URLs are recorded in city-5322-surendranagar.json. First-party sources establish Gujarat district/taluka land-record custody and municipal map context, not open citywide parcel geometry coverage.
requestOutcomes: AnyRoR timed out on the bounded TLS-verified request. Gujarat State GIS returned no usable configuration and web retrieval reported 502. Surendranagar Municipal Corporation maps loaded with HTTP 200 but exposed only thematic/boundary maps. A certificate-chain error was observed on an AnyRoR request and was not bypassed because no exception was authorized. No login, credentials, private token, unsafe field request, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass or TLS disablement was used.
attemptedRoutes: Government of Gujarat District Surendranagar land-records page
Surendranagar Municipal Corporation official maps page
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [22.7249644406895, 71.6443345022146] was preserved in latitude/longitude order and never shifted; no exact-point hit/miss inference was made.
No Surendranagar parcel geometry, stable native parcel identity, source parcel schema, CRS or bounded map/API response was retrieved.
Municipal contour, inundation and boundary maps are not parcel samples and do not establish citywide parcel coverage.
Timeouts, 502, certificate-chain failure and incomplete route access are not evidence that Surendranagar lacks cadastral records.
No owner, address, titleholder, contact, tax/account or other personal/sensitive fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion is research evidence only and does not qualify or admit a runtime adapter; serial reviewer qualification remains pending.
